label: ETF Pullback below the 10-Day Average above the 200-Day (published rules)
about: The published rules of a simple pullback system, tested as written on every unleveraged ETF: when the close is above the 200-day average and below the 10-day average, buy at the next open; sell once the close is back above the 10-day average, with a 10% stop. Added Nov 25, 2026 in place of the paywalled stochastic-pullback page the daily review could not read.

source.title: Stock Soft Research: A Simple Pullback Strategy - Full Test Results And Rules
source.rules: Buy at the next day's open when the close is above the 200-day moving average and below the 10-day moving average. Sell at the next day's open after a close above the 10-day moving average, or by a 10% stop loss. SPY daily 1995-2018: in-sample 229 trades, 76.9% winners, +0.53% a trade, 5.3 bars held; out-of-sample 2010-2018 163 trades, 72.4% winners, +0.31% a trade. Rules and AmiBroker code shown openly on the page.
adapted: The desk sells at the close of the day the close is back above the 10-day average, the page at the next day's open.
The next-open entry is a limit 5% above the signal close, so it fills at the open unless the open gaps up more than 5%.
The 10% stop is set from the signal close rather than the fill price.
Tested on every unleveraged ETF (the page reports SPY and says it also worked on large ETFs), with a 15-session hold limit the page does not have (its trades averaged about 5 sessions).
